what: Measured local-convolution causal reference: single-step out-of-cone ENERGY fraction beyond the 300 m/s Lamb-wave cone (6480 km per 6 h step) on ERA5, the same statistic on the same grid as the released-checkpoint rows of results/tables/deployed/deployed_fleet.csv.
why_this_file_exists: The local-reference row of deployed_fleet.csv previously stored 0.05 percent. That value was a definitional constant carried beside an area fraction of exactly 0.0 in the multi-model cone-law record, with no producing per-cell measurement behind it. It also sits 9.43 times below the 0.4713 percent out-of-cone footprint that the 500 km Gaussian probe itself has at t = 0, so no operator, including the identity map, can attain it. This file holds the four measured cells behind the value the table now prints, 0.49 percent at n = 4.
source_record: gpu_battery_multimodel.json in the private research tree; the ERA5 inputs and the multi-gigabyte checkpoints are outside the boundary declared in data/manifest.json, so the producing record is not shipped here and its digest is pinned below instead
independent_unit: probed cell (initial-condition date x region); n = 4, two dates crossed with two regions
shipped_row: deployed_fleet.csv, local CNN row: 0.49 percent at n = 4, rounded from energy_frac_beyond_300ms_mean
retired_value_status: withdrawn; retained here only to name what the 0.49 percent measurement replaced
protocol_causal_floor_source: round-two initial-condition error-bar record, per-sample causal_floor_fraction (the probe's own t = 0 out-of-cone footprint); not shipped in this repository
